descriptors.concept_name: Group Audit Responsibilities and Component Disclosures
descriptors.definition: When the parent auditor does not audit all group components, responsibilities are divided between auditors. The consolidated audit report must disclose the magnitude of unaudited or other-auditor components using aggregate amounts or percentages.
inclusion: Disclosure of aggregate rupee amounts or percentages of total assets, revenues, and cash flows of components audited by other auditors
exclusion: Audits where the parent auditor audits all components directly
nearby_distinctions: Differs from single-auditor group audits where no division of responsibility exists.

descriptors.definition: When component financial statements follow a different accounting framework than the parent, management converts the statements or uses group accounting policies. The principal auditor audits these conversion adjustments to ensure suitability for consolidation.
inclusion: Conversion of local GAAP or IFRS financial statements to the parent framework
Audit of conversion adjustments by the principal auditor
exclusion: Components already reporting under the identical GAAP as the parent
nearby_distinctions: Focuses on financial reporting frameworks rather than auditing standard differences.

descriptors.definition: Component audits should ideally be performed under auditing standards corresponding to Indian GAAS to maintain consistency. This enables the parent auditor to rely upon and reference the other auditor's report in the consolidated financial statements.
inclusion: Auditing component financial statements using standards corresponding to Indian GAAS
exclusion: Components evaluated strictly under local auditing frameworks without alignment considerations
nearby_distinctions: Distinct from accounting framework (GAAP) differences handled via financial statement conversions.

descriptors.definition: All group components should generally be subjected to an audit or audit procedures. If any component remains unaudited, the group auditor must evaluate qualitative and quantitative factors to determine potential report modifications.
inclusion: Evaluation of unaudited component balances affecting consolidated financial statements
exclusion: Components that have completed independent audits or specified audit procedures
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from audited components with different GAAS/GAAP frameworks by the absolute lack of audit evidence.
